metadata.title: Nahum
metadata.subtitle: Nahum 1:1 – 3:19 (16 questions)
metadata.description: Questions on the Book of Nahum according to the King James Version (1769).
metadata.author: King James Version (1769)

questions.text: How does Nahum 1:2-3 declare the nature of the LORD?

options.text: As a gentle shepherd, long-suffering and without wrath toward sinners
As a jealous God, and a revenger; slow to anger, and great in power
As a distant Creator, taking no regard of the wickedness of nations
As a hidden judge, who watcheth only over the boundaries of Nineveh

questions.text: What comfort does Nahum 1:7 declare for the day of trouble?

options.text: The LORD sendeth heavenly messengers and granteth continual peace
The LORD delivereth from every peril and rooteth out all adversaries
The LORD is good, a strong hold, and knoweth them that trust in him
The LORD overthroweth all foes and maketh his heritage dwell in wealth

questions.text: What good tidings are proclaimed in Nahum 1:15?

options.text: The great victory over Assyria, cried by a swift horseman in Judah
The end of heavy captivity, sung by holy priests upon Zion's bulwarks
The sudden fall of Nineveh, proclaimed from watchtowers with trumpets
The feet of him upon the mountains that bringeth tidings and peace

questions.text: How does Nahum 2:4 describe the raging of the chariots?

options.text: They rage in streets, seem like torches, and run like the lightnings
They charge over high ramparts, their wheels rattling against gates
They carry burning brands and cast boiling pitch into open houses
They gather before gates, cutting off all fleeing citizens in haste

questions.text: What does Nahum 2:7 prophesy concerning the queen and her maids?

options.text: She shall be preserved and received peacefully by neighbouring kings
She shall be led away captive, and her maids lead her as with doves
She shall escape unto high mountains, and all her warriors follow her
She shall be set upon a throne, and her maidens sing joyful canticles

questions.text: To what animal does Nahum 2:12 liken the former power of Nineveh?

options.text: A wild ox that breaketh down fences and treadeth down green fields
A proud eagle that soareth high in the heavens and taketh the prey
A lion that did tear in pieces for his whelps, and filled his dens
A ravening wolf that spoileth the helpless flocks in darkest night

questions.text: What name is given to Nineveh in Nahum 3:1?

options.text: Sinful city, full of snares and deceitful craft
Idolatrous city, full of images and abominations
Haughty city, full of gold and vanishing glory
Bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery

questions.text: What city is held up to Nineveh as a warning in Nahum 3:8?

options.text: Populous No, that was situate among the waters
Tyre, the fenced fortress standing by the sea
Babylon, the proud kingdom beside the Euphrates
Sidon, the wealthy merchant city upon the coast

questions.text: With what lament unto the king of Assyria does Nahum 3:18 conclude?

options.text: Thy palace shall be built again, and thy messengers return in peace
Thy shepherds slumber, thy people is scattered, and no man gathereth
Thy host goeth forth victorious, and thy nobles bear rule for ever
Thy fortress endureth the tempest, and thy servants keep the gates

questions.text: From what place was the prophet Nahum according to Nahum 1:1?

options.text: The Elkoshite
From Tekoa
From Anathoth
From Moresheth

questions.text: How does Nahum 1:6 describe the indignation and fury of the LORD?

options.text: His wrath bloweth as a whirlwind, and tall cedars bow to the earth
His wrath breaketh as great hailstones, and groves are consumed away
His fury is poured out like fire, and rocks are thrown down by him
His fury rusheth as an overflowing torrent, and valleys are dried up

questions.text: What does the LORD promise unto Judah in Nahum 1:13?

options.text: To overlay the yoke with gold as a solemn token of chastisement
To humble Judah once more and punish her before the proud heathen
To double the heavy burden and make fast the iron bonds upon them
To break his yoke from off thee, and burst thy bonds in sunder

questions.text: What command is proclaimed concerning Nineveh's treasures in Nahum 2:9?

options.text: Take the spoil of silver and gold: there is none end of the store
Divide the silver and gold: for the poor and fatherless wait for it
Number the silver and gold: for the king demandeth an exact account
Keep the silver and gold: for fierce adversaries are at the portals

questions.text: With what figure does Nahum 3:4 describe the city of Nineveh?

options.text: A cruel serpent that benumbed the nations with her deadly venom
A wellfavoured harlot, selling nations through her witchcrafts
A stately queen that bought the rulers of the earth with her gold
A fierce lioness that tore the weak in pieces without any pity

questions.text: To what does Nahum 3:12 liken all the strongholds of Nineveh?

options.text: Olive trees whose branches break in the tempest and are burned with fire
Vine branches whose pleasant clusters the strong east wind throweth down
Fig trees with firstripe figs, which shaken fall into mouth of eater
Date palms whose withered fruit drop upon the barren sand in great heat

questions.text: To what insects are Nineveh's people and captains likened in Nahum 3:15-17?

options.text: Unto poisonous serpents and venomous scorpions
Unto flying ravens and vultures in the valley
Unto fierce hornets and bees around the wall
Unto cankerworms, locusts, and grasshoppers
